memberdef.name: XTft_WriteChar

briefdescription.para: Draws a character glyph at a screen position.

detaileddescription.para: This function writes a particular character onto the screen using the character bitmap values.

parameterdescription.para: Value of the starting column. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Value of the starting row. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).
Value with which the pixels are filled to highlight the character.
Value with which the pixels are filled with a different color from foreground.

simplesect.para: It must be taken care that the ASCII character which is to be written has value greater than 31 as character bitmap array starts with space as its first character.

detaileddescription.para: This function initializes a TFT Driver Instance.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XTft instance to initialize.
Pointer to a XTft_Config configuration structure, whose contents are copied into the configuration structure within XTft.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. If the address translation is not used then the physical address is passed. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping is changed after this function is invoked.

briefdescription.para: Updates the cursor column and row.

detaileddescription.para: This function updates the column, row position in the Instance structure of driver.

parameterdescription.para: Column number to which ColVal member of Instance structure is updated. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Row number to which RowVal member of Instance structure is updated. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).

briefdescription.para: Updates the cursor so the next character fits.

detaileddescription.para: This function changes the column, row position in the Instance structure of driver. It is used to correct the position for the next character to be written if column and row position cross limits.

parameterdescription.para: Column number to which ColVal member of Instance structure is updated. If ColVal crosses (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1) - XTFT_CHAR_WIDTH, position is moved to next line. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).

Row number to which RowVal member of Instance structure is updated. If RowVal crosses (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1)- XTFT_CHAR_HEIGHT, the first line is deleted. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).

simplesect.para: This function differs from the function XTft_SetPos because you cannot move to any position on the screen as we have to check for enough space for a character to be written.

briefdescription.para: Sets the foreground and background colors.

detaileddescription.para: This function changes the color values in the instance structure of driver.

parameterdescription.para: Color with which member FgColor of Instance structure is updated.
Color with which member BgColor of Instance structure is updated.

simplesect.para: Color Values must be 32bit. They can range from 0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF, out of these only 18 bits are valid data. These 18 bits contain the Red, Green, Blue color values with 6 bits each and bit positions as Red[8-13], Green[16-21], Blue[24-29].

memberdef.argsstring: (XTft *InstancePtr, u32 ColVal, u32 RowVal, u32 PixelVal)
memberdef.name: XTft_SetPixel

briefdescription.para: Writes a pixel color at a column and row.

detaileddescription.para: This function sets the pixel with the given color at the given column, row position.

parameterdescription.para: Represents the column on the screen. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Represents the row on the screen. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).
Represents the color with which it is filled on screen.

simplesect.para: This API is independent of the interface the TFT Controller is connected to. The data is written to the Video Memory.

briefdescription.para: Reads a pixel color at a column and row.

detaileddescription.para: This function gets the color of the pixel at the given column, row position.

parameterdescription.para: Represents the column on the screen. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Represents the row on the screen. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).
Stores the color value on the screen pointed by given Column and Row position.

simplesect.para: This API is independent of the interface the TFT Controller is connected to. The data is read from the Video Memory.

briefdescription.para: Writes a character or handles CR/LF at the cursor.

detaileddescription.para:
This function performs one of the following three operations based on the CharValue passed :
Move the position to the next line at the same position.
Move the position to the next line.
Write a particular character and update the column position by the width of the character.

parameterdescription.para: ASCII code value of the character to be written.

simplesect.para: As the character bitmap array does not support some of the ASCII values, to support some of those which carry significance in display are added in the switch case. If there is a necessity for any other characters, it can be added here.

briefdescription.para: Scrolls the screen up by one character row.

detaileddescription.para: This function inserts a new blank line at the bottom of the screen, it deletes the first line and moves the remaining lines up by one line.

briefdescription.para: Fills the screen with the background color.

detaileddescription.para: This function re-initializes all the pixels to the default background color.

memberdef.argsstring: (XTft *InstancePtr, u32 ColStartVal, u32 RowStartVal, u32 ColEndVal, u32 RowEndVal, u32 PixelVal)
memberdef.name: XTft_FillScreen

briefdescription.para: Fills a rectangle with a pixel color.

detaileddescription.para: This function fills the screen with the range defined by the start and end values of column and row with the color passed as argument.

parameterdescription.para: Value of the starting column. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Value of the starting row. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).
Value of the ending column. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_WIDTH - 1).
Value of the ending row. The valid values are 0 to (XTFT_DISPLAY_HEIGHT - 1).
Represents the color with which it is filled on screen.

simplesect.para: It must be taken care to pass values such that column start position should not exceed column end position, same is the case with row position.

detaileddescription.para: This function enables the TFT display by setting the Display Enable bit in the Control register.
This function disables the TFT display by clearing the Display Enable bit in the Control register.
This function enables reverse scan by setting the Display Scan Control(DPS) bit in the Control register.

simplesect.para: By default the scan direction is reverse, the image we see in reverse scan mode is the horizontal and vertical mirror image of the image in normal scan mode.

detaileddescription.para: This function enables normal scan by clearing the Display Scan Control(DPS) bit in the Control register.

briefdescription.para: Sets the video memory base address.

detaileddescription.para: This function changes the Video Memory Base address stored in the Address Register.

parameterdescription.para: New memory address value to be written to the Address register.

simplesect.para: The new memory address must be in the address range of external memory and it must be taken care that 2MB memory is available from this new address so that frame data to 640*480 screen can be written.

briefdescription.para: Writes a 32-bit value to a TFT register.

detaileddescription.para: Write a value to a TFT register. A 32 bit write is performed.

parameterdescription.para: Register offset from the base to write to.

briefdescription.para: Reads a 32-bit value from a TFT register.

detaileddescription.para: Read a value from a TFT register. A 32 bit read is performed.

parameterdescription.para: Register offset from the base to read from.

detaileddescription.para: This function enables the Vsync Interrupt in the Interrupt Enable and Status Register.
This function disables the Vsync Interrupt in the Interrupt Enable and Status Register.
This function gets the Vsync(Video address latch) status from the Interrupt Enable and Status Register.

listitem.para: TRUE if Vsync pulse has occurred after displaying the current frame.
FALSE if the TFT core has not completed displaying the current frame.

simplesect.para: Vsync(Video address latch) status bit is cleared by the HW after it loads the address from the Address Register and starts displaying the Frame.

briefdescription.para: Looks up TFT configuration by ID or base address.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the unique device ID/BaseAddress. The XTft_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

parameterdescription.para: Contains the base address of the device.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found, or NULL if the specified device ID or base address was not found. See xtft.h for the definition of XTft_Config.
In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

detaileddescription.para: Compression method for the character bitmaps.

simplesect.para: Packed value with a7 in bit 7 down to a0 in bit 0.
